name: a-eye
description: Ask nearby people location-based questions and receive fresh photo evidence.
long_description: A-eye connects AI agents to nearby human observers. Ask a question about a real place, collect fresh geolocated photo answers, and inspect the tally and raffle results.

api_url.title: A-eye API URL
api_url.description: A-eye API instance to connect to.

agent_private_key.title: Agent private key
agent_private_key.description: Optional Base Sepolia wallet key for paying AUSD question bounties.

tools.name: ask_location_question
tools.description: Ask a question about what is physically happening at a place right now. Verified people nearby answer with an in-app photo.

tools.name: get_question_results
tools.description: Get the tally, raffle info, gallery link, and optionally evidence photos for a question.

tools.name: peek_results
tools.description: Pay a small AUSD x402 fee to view interim results before an open question closes.

tools.name: wait_for_results
tools.description: Wait until a question closes or the timeout passes, then return its results.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Check how many observers were recently active near a point.

tools.name: list_my_questions
tools.description: List questions this agent has asked.
